why_ai: Physical presses, makeready and bindery need hands-on operators, and AI cannot produce paper output.
why_clarity: Jobs are specified by quantity, stock and colour, and checked against proofs on press.
why_digital: Digital files go to press floors that deliver physical printed goods, often to local clients.

why_ai: Cutting, folding and binding are labour-intensive physical steps on machines operators set up.
why_clarity: Finished pieces match the spec and count or they do not, checked at the machine.
why_digital: Printed sheets are physically finished into products on the shop floor.

why_ai: Owning the colour reference system brands specify in is a standard AI cannot replace.
why_clarity: Spectral definitions are exact and matches are verified instantly by instrument.
why_digital: Colour libraries and software are digital, with physical guides and instruments sold globally.

why_ai: Makeready colour matching on press is tacit, hands-on work by experienced pressmen.
why_clarity: Colour and registration are measured against proofs, job after job.
why_digital: Digital prepress feeds physical offset presses that deliver printed product.

why_ai: Address hygiene and presort are data processing, protected partly by licensed postal processing status.
why_clarity: Addresses validate and mailings qualify for postage rates by exact postal rules.
why_digital: Address lists in, cleaned files and presort documentation out, all digital.

why_ai: Technicians troubleshoot ink and runnability at the customer's press to hold the account.
why_clarity: Fixes are visible on the next sheets, but each press and substrate problem differs.
why_digital: Physical ink, press-side visits and lab formulation work.

why_ai: The tactile hand-made impression is the product, intentionally manual by design.
why_clarity: Quality is tactile and aesthetic, and most jobs are bespoke.
why_digital: Designs arrive digitally but are printed by hand on analog presses.

why_ai: Physical converting stays hands-on, and label errors carry regulatory liability.
why_clarity: Artwork, barcodes and nutrition panels must match exact regulatory specifications.
why_digital: Digital artwork drives physical flexo and digital presses that ship labels and packaging.

why_ai: Drop, compression and vibration tests are physical procedures on real packs.
why_clarity: Standard test protocols yield pass or fail results on each pack design.
why_digital: Physical packs are tested in the lab, with reports delivered digitally.

why_ai: Reporter judgment over confidential trader submissions yields benchmarks contracts settle against.
why_clarity: Methodology exists, but an assessed price has no exact ground truth.
why_digital: Transaction reports and interviews in, published price indices out.

why_ai: Telemetry from thousands of presses is proprietary, though its analysis automates.
why_clarity: Uptime, makeready duration and waste are measured continuously from sensors.
why_digital: Machine telemetry analysed into benchmarks and maintenance predictions.

why_ai: Certification bodies own the specification and audit plants, a role AI cannot assume.
why_clarity: Process control targets are numeric and audits measure conformance.
why_digital: Measurement data is digital, with on-site audits and training.

why_ai: Standard quotes automate from estimate-versus-actual data, while complex job pricing keeps judgment.
why_clarity: Estimators handle many RFQs daily, but accuracy is known only after job costing.
why_digital: Job specifications in, quotes out, worked in MIS on screen.

why_ai: Per-quote estimating from specifications is directly substituted by AI estimating tools.
why_clarity: Quotes are produced from specs in a standard way, at high repetition.
why_digital: Specifications in and estimates out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Ratio studies on falling member participation are easily substituted by other data.
why_clarity: Financial ratios and wage surveys follow fixed definitions each year.
why_digital: Member submissions in, published research out, all digital.

why_ai: Bankers broker consolidation deals through owner relationships and on-site equipment diligence.
why_clarity: Each deal is bespoke and whether value was maximised is never known.
why_digital: Valuations are produced on screen, but owners are won in person.

why_ai: Estimate-versus-actual data across thousands of shops is proprietary, though analysis on it automates.
why_clarity: Estimated and actual job costs are compared exactly on continuous job flow.
why_digital: Job costing and shop floor data analysed inside MIS software.

why_ai: Price benchmarking and sourcing events are analytics that AI procurement tools replicate.
why_clarity: Quoted versus awarded prices and spend savings are measurable per sourcing event.
why_digital: Quotes, specs and spend data are handled entirely on screen.

why_ai: Physical printing for local churches relies on long relationships and seasonal reorders.
why_clarity: Recurring bulletins and campaigns are templated and checked on delivery.
why_digital: Printed goods for local congregations ordered through personal contact.

why_ai: Accredited auditors must visit facilities and attest to chain of custody.
why_clarity: Certification criteria are codified and audited annually, though claims are partly self-reported.
why_digital: On-site audits feed digital certificates and records.

why_ai: Physical output is needed, but online print services compete hard for standard products.
why_clarity: Business cards and flyers are standard products checked instantly on output.
why_digital: Customer files print on digital presses into physical products for local walk-ins.

why_ai: Installing wraps and signage on vehicles and buildings is hands-on work in unstructured places.
why_clarity: Installations are specified, but multi-component jobs vary widely.
why_digital: Digital files become physical graphics installed on site for local clients.
